monk.description: Spin-kick a 4-block ring, knocking creatures back and setting them on fire for 4 seconds.

monk.name: Sun Salutation
monk.description: Create a 4-block area for 6 seconds giving allies Fire Resistance and Strength I and igniting enemies.

monk.name: Ice Cocoon
monk.description: Encase yourself in ice blocks for 4 seconds, healing 2 health per second inside.

monk.name: Shatter Kick
monk.description: Kick the creature you look at 6 blocks back; if it is frozen, it shatters for double damage.

monk.name: Flowing Counter
monk.description: For 8 seconds, after each dodge your next unarmed hit deals +6 damage and knocks back with a water burst.

monk.name: Rain Dance
monk.description: Create a 5-block area for 6 seconds giving allies Regeneration I and Dolphin's Grace and putting out fires.

monk.name: Arc Palm
monk.description: Strike the creature you look at; lightning arcs to up to 3 creatures within 4 blocks of it.

monk.name: Static Kata
monk.description: For 10 seconds, every fifth unarmed hit stuns the target for 2 seconds.

monk.name: Dawn Bell
monk.description: Ring a bell that clears negative effects from allies within 6 blocks and makes enemies glow for 10 seconds.

monk.name: Mantra of Mercy
monk.description: For 12 seconds, each unarmed hit heals the lowest-health ally within 8 blocks for 2 health.

monk.name: Mind Lift
monk.description: Lift every creature within 5 blocks with Levitation for 2 seconds, then slam them down for fall damage.

monk.name: Mind Splinter
monk.description: Strike the creature you look at, applying Nausea and Slowness and making it take 50% more damage for 6 seconds.

monk.name: Rooted Trunk
monk.description: For 6 seconds, you cannot be knocked back and attackers are poisoned for 3 seconds.

monk.name: Vine Lash
monk.description: Lash the creature you look at up to 8 blocks away, pulling it to you and applying Poison I.

monk.name: Ruyi Toss
monk.description: Hurl a spinning staff that pierces creatures in a 10-block line, damaging and knocking them back.

monk.name: Cloud Somersault
monk.description: Leap 10 blocks forward and gain Slow Falling for 5 seconds.

monk.name: Ancestor's Mercy
monk.description: Create a 5-block area for 5 seconds that heals allies 1 health per second and soulburns enemies.

monk.name: Samsara Turn
monk.description: For 10 seconds, each kill refills your dodge stamina and grants Resistance I for 5 seconds.

monk.name: Drunken Sway
monk.description: For 8 seconds, each hit against you has a 50% chance to miss as you stagger 2 blocks aside.

monk.name: Sleight Palm
monk.description: Strike the creature you look at and steal one of its active potion effects.

monk.name: Zazen Aim
monk.description: For 10 seconds, while standing still, your arrows deal 50% more damage and home in on targets.

monk.name: Lotus Arrows
monk.description: Fire 6 arrows in a ring around you, each applying Slowness II for 4 seconds.

monk.name: Mountain Tea
monk.description: Conjure a flask of tea; drinking it grants Resistance I and Jump Boost II for 60 seconds.

monk.name: Long Road
monk.description: For 20 seconds, sprinting builds Speed up to III and your first hit after sprinting stuns for 1 second.

monk.name: Withering Spores
monk.description: Throw a spore pod that creates a 4-block cloud for 5 s, applying wither I and poison I.

monk.name: Rotroot Grasp
monk.description: Roots in a 6-block cone give enemies slowness V for 2 s and weakness I for 6 s.

monk.name: Mask of Rule
monk.description: Strike the creature you look at, shattering 30% of its armour for 8 s; your summons deal +30% damage to it.

monk.name: Chochin Swarm
monk.description: Summon 3 paper-lantern vexes for 20 s that burst for 3 damage in 2 blocks when they die.

monk.name: Soulflame Rift
monk.description: Open a 4-block rift for 5 s that pulls enemies toward its centre and applies soulburn.

monk.name: Abyssal Gaze
monk.description: Strike the creature you look at with wither II for 6 s and blindness plus darkness for 4 s.

monk.name: Cursed Coin
monk.description: Throw a cursed coin; the creature hit gets slowness II and takes +20% damage for 8 s.

monk.name: Usury Pact
monk.description: For 10 s, each kill drops an extra emerald and refunds 20% of your mana.

monk.name: Gravity Snare
monk.description: Throw a void trap; the first creature to step on it levitates for 3 s and takes 4 void damage.

monk.name: Rift Tether
monk.description: For 8 s, your arrows teleport the creature hit 4 blocks toward you.

monk.name: Void Burrow
monk.description: Build a 3x3 obsidian shelter around you that vanishes after 8 s.

monk.name: Rift Hop
monk.description: Dash 8 blocks through creatures, dealing 4 void damage and blindness for 2 s to each one passed.

blaze.name: Equinox Ring
blaze.description: Release a ring that ignites creatures within 3 blocks and freezes those 3-6 blocks away for 4 seconds.

blaze.name: Cinder Rime
blaze.description: Mark the creature you look at with frost; if it catches fire within 8 seconds, it explodes for 8 damage.

blaze.name: Kettle Bomb
blaze.description: Throw a boiling kettle that bursts in 3 blocks, knocking creatures back 5 blocks and burning them for 3 seconds.

blaze.name: Vapour Dash
blaze.description: Dash 7 blocks on a jet of steam, setting creatures you pass on fire for 4 seconds.

blaze.name: Sunspot
blaze.description: Mark the creature you look at; after 3 seconds, a solar bolt strikes it for 10 fire damage.

blaze.name: Corona Halo
blaze.description: For 10 seconds, a halo zaps the nearest enemy within 5 blocks every second for 3 damage and ignites it.

blaze.name: Phoenix Rebirth
blaze.description: For 30 seconds, lethal damage instead revives you with 6 health and releases a 4-block fire ring.

blaze.name: Solar Lance
blaze.description: Throw a burning lance that deals 8 damage, doubled against undead, and ignites the target for 5 seconds.

blaze.name: Brimstone Slimes
blaze.description: Summon 3 magma cubes for 20 seconds that set creatures they touch on fire.

blaze.name: Infernal Sigil
blaze.description: Mark the creature you look at for 8 seconds; each spell you cast deals 2 soul fire damage to it.

blaze.name: Ember Seed
blaze.description: Throw a seed that sprouts a fire flower, burning enemies within 3 blocks for 4 seconds.

blaze.name: Ashen Renewal
blaze.description: For 12 seconds, killing a burning creature grants you Regeneration II for 4 seconds.

blaze.name: Vermilion Shard
blaze.description: Throw a burning jade shard that sets the target on fire for 4 s and shatters 3 armour for 6 s.

blaze.name: Ninefold Ring
blaze.description: A fire ring bursts 5 blocks around you, burning enemies 3 s; gain Resistance I 5 s per enemy hit, up to 3 stacks.

blaze.name: Wisp Brand
blaze.description: Mark a target for 12 s; if it dies, 3 soulfire bursts hit enemies within 4 blocks with soulburn for 4 s.

blaze.name: Oni Hearth
blaze.description: A 5-block area pulses for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second and soulburning enemies inside.

blaze.name: Firecracker Purse
blaze.description: Throw a pouch that bursts into 5 small fire blasts in 3 blocks, knocking enemies back and burning them 3 s.

blaze.name: Ember Tithe
blaze.description: Mark a target for 15 s; if it dies burning, it drops one extra loot roll and erupts in 3-block flames.

blaze.name: Signal Flare
blaze.description: Fire a flare; enemies within 6 blocks of impact glow for 10 s and burn for 3 s.

blaze.name: Pyre Quiver
blaze.description: For 10 s your arrows ignite targets and deal +3 fire damage to targets already burning.

blaze.name: Searing Sands
blaze.description: Blast a 6-block cone of hot sand that blinds enemies 3 s and burns them 2 s.

blaze.name: Sunbaked Flatbread
blaze.description: Conjure flatbread; eating it grants Fire Resistance 60 s and Speed I 30 s.

blaze.name: Bamboo Palisade
blaze.description: Raise a bamboo wall 5 blocks wide and 3 tall in front of you for 8 s.

blaze.name: Sapjade Bark
blaze.description: For 10 s, when hurt you heal 2 HP and the attacker loses 10% armour for 5 s.

blaze.name: Kami Swarm
blaze.description: Summon 3 spirit bees for 20 s whose stings apply soulburn for 3 s.

blaze.name: Mossbound Circle
blaze.description: A 5-block circle pulses for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second, doubled on grass.

blaze.name: Glitter Bait
blaze.description: Throw a shiny trinket that pulls mobs within 6 blocks toward it over 3 s.

blaze.name: Thieving Talon
blaze.description: Strike the creature you look at with slowness II for 4 s and a 30% chance to drop one of its loot items.

blaze.name: Bramble Shot
blaze.description: Your next arrow roots the target with slowness VI for 3 s and makes it glow for 8 s.

blaze.name: Leafen Hide
blaze.description: Build a leaf-block hide around you; for 10 s you are invisible and deal +20% ranged damage.

blaze.name: Trailblaze
blaze.description: Gain speed II for 12 s; each kill during it restores 2 hunger.

blaze.name: Wildroot Stew
blaze.description: Conjure 2 bowls of stew that restore 8 hunger and grant resistance I for 60 s.

frost.name: Brine Lance
frost.description: Throw a lance of icy brine that freezes the target 3 s and applies Slowness III for 4 s.

frost.name: Undertow Frost
frost.description: Pull all enemies within 6 blocks toward you and freeze them for 3 s.

frost.name: Polar Flash
frost.description: A 6-block cone of auroral light deals lightning damage, blinds 2 s and applies Slowness II 4 s.

frost.name: Borealis Veil
frost.description: For 10 s, attackers that hit you are struck by a small lightning bolt and frozen 2 s, once per 2 s.

frost.name: Hallowed Snowfall
frost.description: A 6-block area snows for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second with Resistance I and slowing undead.

frost.name: Sanctified Icicle
frost.description: Throw a holy icicle that freezes the target 3 s and deals double damage to undead.

frost.name: Winter Pact
frost.description: Sacrifice 4 HP to gain Absorption II and make your hits freeze targets 2 s for 10 s.

frost.name: Glacial Hex
frost.description: Mark a target with Weakness for 10 s; if it dies, frozen shards freeze enemies within 4 blocks for 4 s.

frost.name: Taiga Bulwark
frost.description: Raise a 5-wide wall of packed snow and spruce leaves in front of you for 10 s.

frost.name: Winterberry Bunch
frost.description: Conjure winterberries; eating grants Regeneration II 8 s and immunity to freezing for 60 s.

frost.name: Kagami Frost
frost.description: For 8 s, half of melee damage you take is reflected and freezes the attacker 2 s.

frost.name: Shiro Fracture
frost.description: Strike the looked-at target, freezing it 3 s and shattering 4 armour for 8 s.

frost.name: Yurei Breath
frost.description: Exhale a 5-block cone of ghostly cold that soulburns 3 s and applies Slowness II 4 s.

frost.name: Phantom Drift
frost.description: Glide 5 blocks through enemies, freezing every creature you pass for 2 s.

frost.name: Slick Floor
frost.description: Coat the ground within 4 blocks in ice and gain Speed II for 5 s while enemies slip.

frost.name: Frozen Fingers
frost.description: Strike the looked-at target, freezing it 2 s and stealing one of its positive effects.

frost.name: Snowblind Shot
frost.description: Throw a packed snowball that blinds the target 3 s and applies Slowness II 5 s.

frost.name: Pinning Frost
frost.description: For 10 s your arrows freeze targets in place for 2 s.

frost.name: Snowshoe Bound
frost.description: Leap 8 blocks forward and gain Speed II for 10 s while on snow or ice.

frost.name: Nomad Stew
frost.description: Conjure a hot stew; eating grants Absorption II and Speed I for 60 s.

frost.name: Divine Verdict
frost.description: Mark a target for 10 s; if it dies, lightning strikes the 3 nearest enemies.

frost.name: Thunder Halo
frost.description: A 5-block thunder ring stuns enemies 2 s and heals allies 4 HP.

frost.name: Eldritch Arc
frost.description: Throw a cursed spark that chains to 3 enemies, applying Wither for 4 s.

frost.name: Malign Current
frost.description: For 10 s each kill releases a lightning burst hitting enemies within 3 blocks.

frost.name: Thunderseed
frost.description: Throw a seed that sprouts and calls lightning on impact after 2 s, granting nearby allies Regeneration I.

frost.name: Stag's Crown
frost.description: For 12 s your melee hits knock enemies back 3 blocks and grant you Speed I for 3 s.

frost.name: Raiko Fracture
frost.description: Strike the looked-at target, shattering 5 armour; if its armour reaches 0, it is stunned 2 s.

frost.name: Mirror Bolt
frost.description: Dash 6 blocks; a lightning echo at your start point strikes enemies within 3 blocks after 1 s.

frost.name: Shimenawa Circle
frost.description: A 6-block ring soulburns enemies 4 s with Slowness I and gives allies Speed I for 6 s.

frost.name: Onigiri Offering
frost.description: Conjure a rice ball; eating grants Speed I and Haste II for 45 s.

frost.name: Shock Purse
frost.description: Throw a coin pouch that stuns enemies within 3 blocks of impact for 2 s.

frost.name: Blink Fuse
frost.description: For 6 s, the first time you are hit you teleport 5 blocks away and gain Speed III 3 s.

frost.name: Ball Lightning
frost.description: Launch a slow orb that zaps enemies within 2 blocks of its path every half second.

frost.name: Conductive Mark
frost.description: Mark a target to glow 12 s; arrows hitting it chain lightning to 2 nearby enemies.

frost.name: Wandering Storm
frost.description: For 15 s, while sprinting, enemies within 3 blocks are zapped every second.

frost.name: Storm Jerky
frost.description: Conjure jerky; eating grants Speed II and Jump Boost II for 30 s.

water.name: Galvanic Downpour
water.description: A 6-block area rains for 6 s, dealing lightning damage each second, doubled against wet enemies.

water.name: Stormsurge Leap
water.description: Leap 10 blocks forward; on landing, lightning strikes enemies within 3 blocks.

water.name: Blessed Font
water.description: A 5-block font pulses for 6 s, healing allies 2 HP every 2 s and extinguishing fire.

water.name: Mercy Wave
water.description: A 6-block wave cone heals allies 4 HP and pushes enemies back 4 blocks.

water.name: Abyssal Tether
water.description: Strike the looked-at target within 12 blocks, pulling it to you with Weakness for 5 s.

water.name: Leviathan Hex
water.description: Mark a target to take 1 drowning damage per second for 6 s; if it dies, you heal 4 HP.

water.name: Mangrove Thicket
water.description: Raise a ring of mangrove roots around you for 8 s that blocks enemies.

water.name: Bogberry Brew
water.description: Conjure a brew; drinking grants Regeneration I 15 s and Water Breathing 60 s.

water.name: Shattering Current
water.description: A 6-block water cone knocks enemies back and shatters 3 armour for 6 s.

water.name: Koi Leap
water.description: Dash 6 blocks forward and gain Dolphin's Grace and Speed I for 10 s.

water.name: Bottomless Ladle
water.description: Strike the looked-at target, filling its lungs: drowning damage for 3 s and soulburn 4 s.

water.name: Tolling Bell
water.description: A ghost-bell ring hits enemies within 6 blocks with Glowing and Slowness II for 5 s.

water.name: Grapeshot Blast
water.description: Fire a 6-block cone of scattershot dealing 6 damage and strong knockback.

water.name: Walk the Plank
water.description: Shove the creature you look at 6 blocks away and soak it: Slowness II and Wet for 6 s.

water.name: Spearfisher's Focus
water.description: For 10 s hits on wet or swimming targets deal +50% damage and pull them 2 blocks closer.

water.name: Ink Bomb
water.description: Throw an ink sac that blinds enemies within 3 blocks of impact for 4 s.

water.name: Sea Legs
water.description: For 20 s gain Dolphin's Grace, Water Breathing and immunity to knockback.

water.name: Harbour Light
water.description: Place a light pillar for 15 s giving allies within 8 blocks Night Vision and Regeneration I.

water.name: Broken Halo
water.description: Throw a shattered halo that applies Wither 3 s to the target and heals you 2 HP.

water.name: Fallen Grace
water.description: For 10 s each kill grants you Absorption I and heals allies within 5 blocks 2 HP.

water.name: Heartwood Shelter
water.description: Raise a small azalea dome for 10 s that gives Regeneration II to allies inside.

water.name: Bloom Lash
water.description: A 5-block cone of vines roots enemies with Slowness V 3 s and heals allies 3 HP.

water.name: Heavenly Facet
water.description: Throw a jade prism that bursts in 4 blocks, healing allies 4 HP and giving enemies glowing and -20% armour for 6 s.

water.name: Balanced Judgment
water.description: Strike the creature you look at for holy damage equal to the health-percentage gap between you, minimum 4.

water.name: Kagura Bell
water.description: A 5-block area pulses for 5 s, healing allies 1 HP per second and giving undead slowness II.

water.name: Shide Strike
water.description: Strike the creature you look at for 6 holy damage, doubled against undead, and apply soulburn for 4 s.

water.name: Indulgence Coin
water.description: Throw a gold coin; the creature hit gets weakness II for 6 s and you gain 4 absorption hearts.

water.name: Tithe Strike
water.description: For 8 s, each hit heals you 1 HP and has a 20% chance to drop a gold nugget.

water.name: Sunrise Quiver
water.description: Your next 3 arrows within 10 s make targets glow and deal +4 holy damage to undead.

water.name: Beacon Flare
water.description: Throw a flare that lights a 6-block area for 6 s, giving enemies glowing and allies speed I.

water.name: Blessed Bread
water.description: Conjure 3 bread that restore 6 hunger and grant regeneration I and night vision for 30 s.

water.name: Sanctuary Tent
water.description: Build a 3x3 wool shelter around you for 10 s that grants regeneration I to anyone inside.
